cases.input: Inspect a PPTX against its template profile and confirmed visual reference. The deck is structurally sound, uses space efficiently, has a clear reading path, gives the conclusion appropriate visual weight and keeps sources in a readable safe zone.
requiredBehaviors: use template-specific structural and composition baselines
check both geometric defects and objective composition quality
require render verification after material major or critical corrections
forbiddenBehaviors: declare layout PASS merely because no objects collide
apply universal layout thresholds that contradict the active template
skillAnchors: Template-spezifische Baselines haben Vorrang vor universellen Grenzwerten.
Ein Deck mit kollisionsfreien, aber kompositorisch schwachen Folien darf nicht als Layout-QA-PASS ausgegeben werden.

cases.input: A management slide has no overflow or object collisions, but three oversized cards are mostly empty, the reading order is unclear, the conclusion is visually weaker than supporting cards and the source line is tiny and crowded against the footer.
requiredBehaviors: flag excessive empty container area as a major composition issue
flag insufficient conclusion dominance and weak reading progression
treat unreadable or footer-conflicting source text as a major finding
forbiddenBehaviors: treat dead space inside dominant cards as high-quality whitespace
approve the slide solely because structural collision checks pass

cases.input: A reviewer responds to a compositionally weak slide by adding more badges and icons, shrinking body text to make everything fit and marking PASS without rendering the corrected slide.
requiredBehaviors: reject decorative additions as a substitute for information-architecture correction
keep font-size reduction as the last correction option
reject final layout PASS without rendering materially corrected slides
forbiddenBehaviors: mask weak composition with additive decoration
simulate visual verification from structure alone
skillAnchors: Nicht zulässig:** bestehende Folie lediglich mit zusätzlichen Icons/Badges dekorieren
Bei Text- oder Kompositionsproblemen in dieser Reihenfolge korrigieren:
Ein struktureller Pass ersetzt keinen Render-Test.
